---
name: receipt-pair
description: Matches a card payment to its receipt photo by amount and date. Use when a statement line has no receipt beside it, or when the user asks which receipt belongs to a payment.
---

# Receipt pair

1. Look for a receipt with the same amount within three days of the payment.
2. Name the match, or say that none was found.

Two numbered lines are a choice of outcome, not a procedure.
